status: exact all-multiplicity first-jet index, signed winding theorem, and diagonal boundary-flux reduction; the Xi edge separation and zero-winding family remain open and this is not a proof of Lambda<=0 or RH
proof_boundary: The gate proves sign-definite local contact charge and an exact two-dimensional-to-boundary reduction. It does not prove the bottom/right Xi edge bounds, zero winding, positive-time simplicity, Lambda<=0, or RH.

exact.orientation_convention: The domain has the standard (x,t) orientation: the positively oriented half-rectangle runs along its bottom edge from x=0 to x=R. Reversing the coordinate order to (t,x) reverses every local index and the boundary winding.
exact.root_count_jump: For tau>0, P_m has m simple real Hermite roots. For tau<0, its coefficients have one sign in u^2, so it has zero real roots when m is even and only u=0 when m is odd. The contact therefore births floor(m/2) real pairs.
exact.double_index: At a nondegenerate common zero of (F,F_x), det D_(x,t)(F,F_x)=F_x*F_xt-F_t*F_xx=F_xx^2>0; in the reversed (t,x) coordinate order the determinant is -F_xx^2<0
exact.multiplicity_index: At a real zero of spatial multiplicity m>=2 in any nonzero real-analytic solution F_t=-F_xx, the common-zero point is isolated and its local Brouwer index in the standard (x,t) orientation is +floor(m/2)
exact.global_winding: If Omega is a compact planar domain whose boundary contains no common zero, wind((F+iF_x)(partial Omega),0)=+sum_(p in Omega) floor(m_p/2)>=0 in the standard (x,t) orientation
exact.zero_winding_equivalence: Under boundary nonvanishing, wind(F+iF_x)=0 iff Omega contains no real multiple-zero contact

orientation_audit.coordinate_reversal: Changing (x,t) to (t,x) reverses both local degree and the positive boundary orientation.

exact.xi_half_rectangles: Let Q_j=[1/(5j),1/4]x[0,38+j]. Then Lambda<=0 iff, for every j, Z=H+iH_x is nonzero on partial Q_j and wind(Z(partial Q_j),0)=0
exact.known_edges: On x=0, H_t(0)>0. On t=1/4, all zeros are simple because 1/4>1/5>=Lambda. Thus only the bottom edge t=1/(5j), 0<=x<=38+j and the right edge x=38+j, 1/(5j)<=t<=1/4 need new boundary separation
exact.half_rectangle_flux: For Q=[delta,T]x[0,R], counterclockwise orientation gives 2pi*wind(Z)=-integral_0^R L_delta/Q_delta dx+integral_delta^T L_x(t,R)/Q(t,R)dt+integral_0^R L_T/Q_T dx
exact.countermodel_guard: The universal m=2 and m=4 heat contacts have winding +1 and +2 respectively in the standard (x,t) orientation. Top-edge simplicity, axis positivity, or forward real-rootedness alone does not force zero winding.
exact.proof_handoff: For every diagonal half-rectangle, prove first-jet separation on the bottom and right edges and prove that the displayed phase-flux integer is zero. This is a one-dimensional boundary theorem with sign-definite interior charges; it is not yet supplied by the compact certificate, the dominant ray, root-field balance, or generic heat-flow topology.

rows.claim: Every real multiple contact has a universal Hermite heat-polynomial tangent.
rows.proof_boundary: Parabolic leading-order model; higher terms do not change the local degree.

rows.claim: The universal contact has no secondary multiple-zero time.
An m-fold contact creates exactly floor(m/2) real pairs.
rows.formula: For tau>0, P_m has m simple real Hermite roots. For tau<0, its coefficients have one sign in u^2, so it has zero real roots when m is even and only u=0 when m is odd. The contact therefore births floor(m/2) real pairs.
rows.proof_boundary: Uses simplicity of Hermite roots and coefficient positivity for negative time.

rows.claim: Every resolved pair birth has positive unit index in the standard (x,t) orientation, so an m-fold contact has index +floor(m/2).
rows.formula: At a nondegenerate common zero of (F,F_x), det D_(x,t)(F,F_x)=F_x*F_xt-F_t*F_xx=F_xx^2>0; in the reversed (t,x) coordinate order the determinant is -F_xx^2<0; At a real zero of spatial multiplicity m>=2 in any nonzero real-analytic solution F_t=-F_xx, the common-zero point is isolated and its local Brouwer index in the standard (x,t) orientation is +floor(m/2)
rows.proof_boundary: The index is local and independent of Xi arithmetic.

rows.claim: Interior contacts cannot cancel in first-jet winding.
rows.formula: If Omega is a compact planar domain whose boundary contains no common zero, wind((F+iF_x)(partial Omega),0)=+sum_(p in Omega) floor(m_p/2)>=0 in the standard (x,t) orientation; Under boundary nonvanishing, wind(F+iF_x)=0 iff Omega contains no real multiple-zero contact
rows.proof_boundary: Requires first-jet nonvanishing on the chosen boundary.

rows.claim: The first-jet winding is an explicit Laguerre phase flux.
rows.formula: Q=H^2+H_x^2; L=H_x^2-H*H_xx; partial_x arg(H+iH_x)=-L/Q; partial_t arg(H+iH_x)=L_x/Q; d arg(H+iH_x)=-(L/Q)dx+(L_x/Q)dt
rows.proof_boundary: Valid only away from common zeros, as required on the boundary.

rows.claim: The positive Newman direction is equivalent to zero winding on a linear half-rectangle exhaustion.
rows.formula: Let Q_j=[1/(5j),1/4]x[0,38+j]. Then Lambda<=0 iff, for every j, Z=H+iH_x is nonzero on partial Q_j and wind(Z(partial Q_j),0)=0
rows.proof_boundary: Uses positive-boundary attainment, evenness, and independent diagonal exhaustion.

rows.claim: The top and symmetry-axis edges are already contact-free.
rows.formula: On x=0, H_t(0)>0. On t=1/4, all zeros are simple because 1/4>1/5>=Lambda. Thus only the bottom edge t=1/(5j), 0<=x<=38+j and the right edge x=38+j, 1/(5j)<=t<=1/4 need new boundary separation; For Q=[delta,T]x[0,R], counterclockwise orientation gives 2pi*wind(Z)=-integral_0^R L_delta/Q_delta dx+integral_delta^T L_x(t,R)/Q(t,R)dt+integral_0^R L_T/Q_T dx
rows.proof_boundary: The bottom and right edge estimates remain open.

rows.claim: Generic heat-flow structure does not make the winding vanish.
rows.formula: The universal m=2 and m=4 heat contacts have winding +1 and +2 respectively in the standard (x,t) orientation. Top-edge simplicity, axis positivity, or forward real-rootedness alone does not force zero winding.
rows.proof_boundary: Blocks promotion from top-time real-rootedness or axis positivity.

rows.claim: Close two one-dimensional first-jet edges and one integer phase-flux condition at every stage.
rows.formula: For every diagonal half-rectangle, prove first-jet separation on the bottom and right edges and prove that the displayed phase-flux integer is zero. This is a one-dimensional boundary theorem with sign-definite interior charges; it is not yet supplied by the compact certificate, the dominant ray, root-field balance, or generic heat-flow topology.
rows.proof_boundary: No unbounded Xi edge or winding value is certified here.
